canonical_definition: MMBench (Multimodal Benchmark) is a general multimodal evaluation framework used to assess the understanding and reasoning capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs) across diverse perception and reasoning tasks. It is often framed as a comprehensive or all-around benchmark, encompassing subsets or variants such as MMBenchCN (Chinese-focused) and related benchmarks like MM-Vet and MMStar. While some papers emphasize its role in evaluating "general multimodal understanding," others highlight its application to multidimensional capability assessment, typically reported via accuracy scores or overall scores in experimental contexts.
